comment: Single source of write permissions. First matching glob wins. ** = any depth, * = one path segment. Owners: template (fleet/** and templates/**; only fleet/scripts/upgrade.sh, BOT_FLEET_UPGRADE=1), manager, self (bots/<slug>/ = bot <slug>). 'create' lists roles that may ADD new files under a self-owned tree (seeding a new bot / restore). examples/** exists only in the template repo (not copied to fleets; validated there only); in a fleet it is read-only if present. template/** and manager/** hold only 0.10.0 compatibility symlinks to the old paths (fleet/scripts/compat.sh); removed after every live prompt is re-rendered.
